product.title: Borealis Wall
product.description: Borealis Wall is a concrete wall block that replicates the look of rustic wood without the maintenance. With its realistic wood-grain texture and warm tones, it’s ideal for creating garden walls, outdoor kitchens, edging, flowerbeds, firepits, benches, and water features.

specs.name: Profile
specs.value: Five-sided, fully finished on visible surfaces (3 sides and 2 edges)

specs.name: Weather Resistant
specs.value: Designed to endure freeze-thaw cycles and seasonal changes

specs.name: Maintenance
specs.value: Minimal – no sealing or staining required (high gloss sealer can be applied to match the Borealis slabs if desired)

features: Rustic wood look with authentic grain texture inspired by natural timber
Strong concrete construction that resists fading, warping, and deterioration over time
One authentic wood-grain finish for a natural aesthetic
Suitable for garden walls, outdoor kitchens, edging, flowerbeds, firepits, benches, and water features
Low-maintenance alternative to wood with long-lasting performance in all climates
Covered by Techo-Bloc’s limited lifetime warranty on structural integrity
